review: The intended older validator exists at candidate-function-ledger-validator-16298/001. Fresh replay reproduces its diagnostic results over revision-001 queue and clock ledgers: 20 function records verified and 18 targeted mutation cases rejected (nine per ledger). It validates image identity/hash, stable entry IDs, single-range image mapping, source bytes, instruction and pseudocode hashes, instruction tiling and direct calls, duplicate IDs, non-overlap, and accepted:false draft status.
limitations: This is a byte/evidence validator for a narrow Apollo-main Thumb schema, not semantic or architectural verification.
It does not bind reviews or establish image-wide coverage/admission; newer target/path-bound 16302 validator is a separate later snapshot.
No C or freeze gate changes.
